summary.pt: Aplicações web de back-office e entrega de ponta a ponta em Kubernetes no GCP.
summary.en: Back-office web applications and end-to-end delivery on Kubernetes in GCP.

pt: Responsável de ponta a ponta por entrega, monitoramento e suporte de aplicações legadas e novas em contêineres no Kubernetes (Google Cloud Platform).
Projetei e desenvolvi aplicações web de back-office com Node.js, Next.js, React, micro-frontends e design system.
Promovi boas práticas de CI/CD com GitHub Actions (build, teste e deploy).
Participei da migração de pipelines de ingestão de dados da AWS para o GCP com o time de Data Platform.
Implementei frameworks de teste A/B para apoiar hipóteses de produto.
en: Owned end-to-end delivery, monitoring and support of legacy and new applications in containers on Kubernetes (Google Cloud Platform).
Designed and developed back-office web applications with Node.js, Next.js, React, micro-frontends and a design system.
Championed CI/CD best practices with GitHub Actions (build, test and deploy).
Took part in migrating data ingestion pipelines from AWS to GCP with the Data Platform team.
Implemented A/B testing frameworks to support product hypotheses.
